title: Canadian Rockies and the Rocky Mountaineer: Calgary, Banff, Lake Louise, Jasper and Vancouver
meta_title: Canadian Rockies 8 Days with the Rocky Mountaineer
meta_description: 8-day Canadian Rockies tour: a helicopter flight, Banff, Yoho and Lake Louise, the Icefields Parkway to Jasper, and the Rocky Mountaineer to Vancouver.

tagline: Turquoise lakes, a glacier and two days on Canada's famous mountain train

Guided coach tours, then the Rocky Mountaineer train
intro: The Canadian Rockies at their best, ending with two days on the Rocky Mountaineer. A helicopter flight over the peaks of Kananaskis on the way to Banff, Yoho's Emerald Lake and a night at Lake Louise, the Icefields Parkway with a ride onto the Athabasca Glacier, two nights in Jasper, then the train through the Yellowhead Pass, past Mount Robson and down the Fraser Canyon to Vancouver, with a night in Kamloops between. The Rocky Mountaineer runs only from about mid-April to mid-October, travels by daylight, and overnights in Kamloops.

faqs.a: SilverLeaf has large windows and meals at your seat; GoldLeaf adds a glass-domed upper deck and a dining room. We quote both.

faqs.q: Can we do it the other way round?
faqs.a: Yes. Vancouver to Calgary works the same; the train goes Vancouver to Jasper.

faqs.q: Can this itinerary be changed for our dates and pace?
faqs.a: Yes. Every Blue Diamond Voyage itinerary is a starting point. We change the number of nights, the hotels, the pace and the activities to suit your family, and send you a personalised quote.

faqs.q: Do you look after vegetarian and Jain food?
faqs.a: Yes. We send your dietary brief to every hotel and guide before you travel, and suggest pure-vegetarian restaurants along the route. Jain meals without onion, garlic and root vegetables can be arranged in most places with notice.

faqs.q: Is there support while we travel?
faqs.a: Yes. You have our 24/7 travel desk on +91 97148 59797 and +91 98242 21400 and a WhatsApp group with your consultant for the whole trip.

good_to_know.title: Hotel deposit
good_to_know.text: Use a credit card for the deposit or pre-authorisation at check-in, never a forex or debit card. Forex cards cannot hold funds, many hotels refuse them, and a credit-card hold is released faster.

good_to_know.title: Cards and cash
good_to_know.text: On card machines, always choose to pay in Canadian dollars, never in INR. Cards work everywhere. Tips of 15 to 20% are expected in restaurants and for guides.

good_to_know.title: Bears and wildlife
good_to_know.text: Black and grizzly bears, elk and bighorn sheep are often seen by the road. Stay in the vehicle, never feed wildlife, and keep at least 100 m from bears.

good_to_know.title: Mountain weather
good_to_know.text: It can snow in the Rockies even in July. Pack layers, a rain jacket and closed shoes.

dining_intro: Banff, Jasper, Calgary and Vancouver all have vegetarian and Indian restaurants, and Vancouver has one of the largest Indian communities in North America. The train serves set menus: we register your diet when we book.
dining_avoid: Soups and gravies often use chicken or beef stock. Ask for vegetarian options and say 'no egg' where needed.
food_card: We are strict vegetarians (Jain). No meat, fish, seafood or eggs. No onion, garlic, potato, carrot or any root vegetables. No meat or fish stock. Thank you.
